_comment: "When this hits, at the beginning of your end phase, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal." Was authored as PUT_TOP_DECK_BOTTOM with zone=arsenal -- a type that does not exist, and whose name says the BOTTOM OF THE DECK, the opposite destination. Nested inside the INJECT_TRIGGER it compiled lazily, so instead of failing at load it raised ValueError at the end phase of any turn this hit. It was removed and tracked in KNOWN_UNIMPLEMENTED until PUT_INTO_ARSENAL existed; three other cards (both Blessing of Focus printings, and Sunkwater Exoshell's mirror direction) turned out to need the same primitive.
